purpose: Fixed multi-turn test set for the chat prototype (author's approved design, 2026-11-26). Written and hashed (multiturn_cases.sha256) BEFORE any multi-turn feature code, never edited afterwards. C01-C11 are design cases. H01-H03 were written by the author and are HELD OUT: the rules are not tuned to them and they are reported separately; their expectations state what a good system should do, not what the rules are expected to produce.
pass_rule: A conversation passes when every deterministic check passes in all 3 runs AND every answer check passes in at least 2 of 3 runs (each run plays the whole conversation from a new, empty conversation).

deterministic.kind: routing outcome of the turn: small_talk | unclear | emotional | question | offer_declined
deterministic.search: alone = the turn's own search text (as single-turn); combined = the anchoring topic text of the earlier turn plus this turn's search text; none = no retrieval
deterministic.fallback: the pipeline fallback was given (below the similarity threshold, no model call)
deterministic.coach: the answer was made in coach mode
deterministic.comparison: the comparison format instruction was appended
deterministic.offer: the fixed reply carries a topic offer line
deterministic.resolved_question: the question actually answered (an accepted topic offer becomes its starter question); null = no resolution happened
deterministic.model_called: a model wrote the answer (false for fixed replies and the pipeline fallback)
deterministic.history_exchanges: number of earlier exchanges sent to the model with this turn
deterministic.min_overlap_with_previous_top5: at least this many of this turn's top-5 chunk IDs are also in the previous model-answered turn's top 5
deterministic.top1_contains: the top-1 retrieved chunk's text contains this word (case-insensitive)
deterministic.top5_contains_all: each word appears (case-insensitive) in at least one of the top-5 retrieved chunks

answer.answered: the model answered: not the fallback sentence alone, at least one valid citation, no citation outside the turn's retrieved set, no malformed citation
answer.table: the answer contains a markdown table (header, separator and at least 2 data rows)
